name: Erebus
intro: Erebus is Nyx's premium big brother, named after Nyx's partner in the myths. It keeps the black slot grille and coloured tubes, but goes upmarket: gloss black-chrome, chrome corners, pointed hex slots, a floating black-chrome EREBUS badge, a violet light line, a chrome lip and knobs with glowing violet pointers.
notes: One full-rig capture of the MKII Ultra, so there is no channel button. Gain pushes the input harder into it.
Full rig: the cab is inside the capture, so the plugin should bypass its own cab section.
If you find more MKII Ultra captures (another channel or gain setting), send them and Erebus gets channel buttons.
